run_exemplarTrainerWrapper: run the exemplarTrainerWrapper with a list of CLI-style parameters for EFT fitting on a pose regressor model
run_eft_fitting_coco: run EFT fitting on the COCO dataset using a pre-trained pose regressor checkpoint with batch size 1
run_eft_fitting_debug_vis: run EFT fitting with debug visualization enabled to visualize the exemplar fine-tuning process on screen
run_eft_fitting_poor_model: run EFT fitting using the weaker MPII pre-trained checkpoint model for comparison purposes
run_eft_fitting_strong_model: run EFT fitting using the strong multi-dataset pre-trained checkpoint with 20 max exemplar iterations
